title: Stablecoin site with lavender flower-hill hero, giant coins, dark navy cards and a 3D temple
whatItIs: A pale grey page with a rounded hero panel: a lilac sky and hills of purple flowers with two huge metallic coins, centred headline 'Where Money Grows' and black button. Below are three cards (one lilac with a coin and coneflower, two dark navy), a logo strip, and a use-cases block with a lilac 3D temple among flowers.
whatItMeans: Soft, growing and trustworthy; nature imagery makes yield feel organic.
techniques: Render metaphor scenes (coins in flower fields) in one lilac palette.
Use big rounded image panels inside a neutral page.
Mix one light card with dark navy cards for contrast.
bestFor: Crypto and DeFi products with a human tone
